timed_text.text: Day 6.
Anxiety shows up in your body before it shows up in your thoughts.
Tight jaw. Raised shoulders. Clenched fists. Shallow breathing.
Today we fix that.
We're going to scan your body from head to toe.
This teaches you to read your own nervous system in real time.
Before we start — take one box breath with me.
Good. Close your eyes.
We're moving from the top of your head down to your feet.
Top of your head. Your forehead. Your eyes.
Is there tension here? Breathe in — and release it on the exhale.
Your jaw. Your neck. Your throat.
Athletes carry a lot here. Breathe in — let it soften.
Your shoulders. Your upper back.
Are they raised right now? Drop them. One slow breath in — and release.
Your chest. Your lungs. Let the breath go all the way down.
Your arms. Your hands. Your fingers. Unclench.
Your core. Your stomach. This is where nerves live.
Breathe into it. Let it expand.
Your hips. Your legs. Your feet. All the way to the floor.
Now — whole body. One full breath in.
Feel everything you just released. And exhale. Let it all go.
Open your eyes.
You just learned how to read your nervous system and reset it in under two minutes.
Aware athletes don't get blindsided by their own bodies.
Go hit the journal.

blocks.prompt: Where did your body hold the most tension? Does that same spot show up when you compete?
